$comment: Shared public-vocabulary shapes for create_entity, update_entity, and get_entity.

entityName.description: Entity identity the customer reads on the page. Unique per tenant including trash. Must not start with assoc_. Slug is derived and read-only.

slug.description: Stable attribute identifier derived from name when omitted. Immutable after create. Used by formulas, aggregates, defaults, and change ops.

groupKey.description: Stable group identifier stored as the group's id. Unique within the entity. Attributes reference it via group.

entitySpec.description: One entity to create. Associations, option sources, and aggregates may name other entities in this same call.

name.description: Entity identity the customer reads on the page. Unique per tenant including trash. Must not start with assoc_. Slug is derived and read-only.

display_label.description: Label shown on the form and in lists. Default the name.

description.description: Optional help text for editors. Default empty.

extends.description: Base model this entity extends, or null for none. Default none. Must be one of the tenant's extendable models.

settings.description: Icon, colour and pre-filled values for this entity. All fields optional.

attribute_groups.description: Named sections on the form. Array order is page order. Default none. At most 30.

items.description: A labelled section of attributes. Create-shaped: omitted icon/color receive defaults.

attributes.description: Fields on this entity. Array order is page order. Default none. At most 150.

items.description: A field on an entity. Create-shaped: omitted kind is input and omitted html_type is text.

associations.description: Links to other entities. Each creates a bridge entity automatically. Default none. At most 20.

items.description: A link to another entity. The bridge entity is created automatically. Cannot point at this entity.

entitySettings.description: Icon, colour and pre-filled values for this entity. All fields optional.

icon.description: Icon key shown for this entity. Default custom.

color.description: Hex colour shown for this entity, including the leading #. Default #6366f1.

default_values.description: Values pre-filled in new entries. Keys are attribute slugs already on this entity. Default empty.

defaultValues.description: Values pre-filled in new entries. Keys are attribute slugs already on this entity. Default empty.

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: Initial value stored under this attribute slug.

attributeGroup.description: A labelled section of attributes. Create-shaped: omitted icon/color receive defaults.

key.description: Stable group identifier stored as the group's id. Unique within the entity. Attributes reference it via group.

name.description: Section heading shown on the form. Unique within the entity, case-insensitive.

description.description: Optional section help text. Default empty.

groupPatch.description: Partial group update. Omitted keys stay as they are. Null clears an optional field. Key is not patchable.

name.description: Replacement section heading. Used by update_group.

description.description: Replacement help text. Null clears it. Used by update_group.

icon.description: Replacement section icon. Same allowed values as attribute_groups icon.

color.description: Replacement section colour token. Same allowed values as attribute_groups color.

attribute.description: A field on an entity. Create-shaped: omitted kind is input and omitted html_type is text.

name.description: Field label used to derive the slug when slug is omitted.

slug.description: Stable attribute identifier derived from name when omitted. Immutable after create. Used by formulas, aggregates, defaults, and change ops.

description.description: Optional help text under the control. Default empty.

kind.description: How the value is produced. Default input. Bridge attributes are always input.

html_type.description: Form control. Default text. Computed attributes are stored as number.

group.description: Group key this field belongs to. Default ungrouped. Must match an attribute_groups key.

rules.description: Attribute rules (validators). Default none. Allowed types depend on html_type. At most 20.

items.description: One attribute rule. Extra value fields depend on the rule type; presence/format rules take none.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types. Ignored on other controls.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

formula.description: Expression over sibling attribute slugs. Required when kind is calculated. Identifiers must be slugs on this entity.

aggregate.description: Computed aggregate through an association bridge. Required when kind is computed.

owner.description: When true, this reference marks which person the record belongs to. Valid only on an entity_entries field whose target is a person entity, at most once per entity. Omit when false. Invalid on person entities, bridge attributes, non-references, and non-person targets.

lifecycle.description: Status lifecycle. Only on select or radio input with static options and exactly one default option. Default none.

allOf.description: Select, radio, and checkbox controls require options.

attributePatch.description: Partial attribute update (JSON Merge Patch). Omitted keys stay as they are. Null clears an optional field. Slug is not patchable.

name.description: Replacement field name. Does not change the slug.

display_label.description: Replacement shown label. Null resets it to the name.

description.description: Replacement help text. Null clears it.

kind.description: Replacement kind: input, calculated, or computed. Breaking when it changes.

html_type.description: Replacement form control. Changing html_type is a breaking change. Same allowed values as attribute html_type.

group.description: Replacement group key. Null ungroups the field.

rules.description: Replacement rule list. Arrays replace wholesale.

items.description: One attribute rule. Same fields as a full rule. type must be allowed for the html_type.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types. Ignored on other controls.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

formula.description: Replacement formula when kind is calculated. Null clears it.

aggregate.description: Computed aggregate through an association bridge. Required when kind is computed.

owner.description: When true, this reference marks which person the record belongs to. Same rules as attribute owner. False or omit clears the flag.

lifecycle.description: Replacement status lifecycle. Arrays replace wholesale. Null clears it.
Status lifecycle. States are the option values; a new record starts at the default option. A save making an unlisted change, or clearing the value, is refused.

transitions.description: Allowed changes. List each from/to pair once.

from.description: Option value the record is in.

to.description: Option value it may move to. Differs from from.

x-enum-descriptions.admin: Tenant admins and the platform owner.
x-enum-descriptions.member: A signed-in member, including processing on their submit.
x-enum-descriptions.system: A write with no person behind it, such as a payment confirmation.

bridgeAttribute.description: An extra input field stored on the association bridge. Always kind input. Same create defaults as attribute.

name.description: Bridge field name. Slug is derived when omitted.

slug.description: Stable attribute identifier derived from name when omitted. Immutable after create. Used by formulas, aggregates, defaults, and change ops.

html_type.description: Form control. Default text. Same allowed values as attribute html_type.

rules.description: Attribute rules. Default none. Allowed types depend on html_type.

items.description: One attribute rule. Same fields as a full rule. type must be allowed for the html_type.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

kind.description: Always input for bridge attributes. Default input. Do not send calculated or computed.

owner.description: When true, this reference marks which person the record belongs to. Invalid on bridge attributes; the semantic validator reports attribute.owner_invalid. Omit when false.

allOf.description: Select, radio, and checkbox bridge fields require options.

bridgeAttributePatch.description: Partial bridge-attribute update (JSON Merge Patch). Omitted keys stay. Null clears an optional field. Slug is not patchable.

name.description: Replacement name. Does not change the slug.

display_label.description: Replacement shown label. Null resets it to the name.

description.description: Replacement help text. Null clears it.

html_type.description: Replacement form control. Same allowed values as attribute html_type.

rules.description: Replacement rule list. Arrays replace wholesale.

items.description: One attribute rule. Same fields as a full rule. type must be allowed for the html_type.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types. Ignored on other controls.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

owner.description: When true, this reference marks which person the record belongs to. Invalid on bridge attributes; the semantic validator reports attribute.owner_invalid. Omit when false.

rule.description: One attribute rule. Extra value fields depend on the rule type; presence/format rules take none.

type.description: Which rule to apply. Each value states the value fields it takes and the html_types it is allowed on; a rule outside that list is rejected with rule.not_allowed.

value.description: Bound for single-value rules such as length_maximum or greater_than. Default none.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for range rules such as length_in_range. Default none.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for range rules. Must be >= min.

pattern.description: Ruby regular expression for format_custom. Default none.

values.description: Allowed or excluded strings for inclusion/exclusion. Default none. At most 200.

allOf.description: Range rules require min and max.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

visible_to.description: Audience flags. Omitted keys default true. Set false to hide or skip rules for that audience.

rules_apply_to.description: Audience flags. Omitted keys default true. Set false to hide or skip rules for that audience.

editable_by.description: Audience flags. Omitted keys default true. Set false to show the field read-only to an audience that sees it, such as a status the system sets that members may read.

audienceFlags.description: Audience flags. Omitted keys default true. Set false to hide or skip rules for that audience.

admin.description: Applies to tenant admins and the platform owner. Default true.

member.description: Applies to signed-in members. Default true.

public.description: Applies to anonymous public visitors. Default true.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types. Ignored on other controls.

values.description: Static choices. Required when source is static. At most 200. Duplicate stored values are rejected.

items.description: One static choice. A string is stored as both label and value.

constant.description: Constant name. Required when source is constant. Customer-owned constants win over shared namesakes.

entity.description: Entity whose entries fill the list. Required when source is entity_entries. May name an entity in this same call.

label_field.description: Slug of a human-readable attribute of that entity (text, search, email, tel, url, number or date) shown as the choice label. The stored value is always the record id.

allOf.description: source entity_entries requires entity and label_field.

optionValue.description: One static choice. A string is stored as both label and value.

anyOf.description: A choice whose label and stored value are this string.
A choice with a distinct label and stored value.

default.description: Whether this choice is pre-selected. Default false.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

accept.description: accept attribute, e.g. .pdf,image/*. Default none (any file).

multiple.description: Whether more than one file may be chosen. Default false.

aggregate.description: Computed aggregate through an association bridge. Required when kind is computed.

related_entity.description: Entity this aggregate walks to. May name an entity in this same call. An association must exist in the declared direction.

function.description: Aggregate function. count does not need source_attribute; the others do.

source_attribute.description: Bridge-attribute slug to aggregate. Required except for count. Must be numeric for avg, sum, min, and max.

precision.description: Decimal places for non-count functions. Default none (unrounded).

filter.description: Keep related bridge rows matching this comparison. Default none (all rows).

direction.description: Which side owns the association. Default source.

aggregateFilter.description: Keep related bridge rows matching this comparison. Default none (all rows).

value.description: Value compared against the filter attribute.

association.description: A link to another entity. The bridge entity is created automatically. Cannot point at this entity.

related_entity.description: Target entity name. May name an entity in this same call.

display_field.description: Slug of a human-readable attribute of the related entity (text, search, email, tel, url, number or date) used as the label of each linked record.

display_field_label.description: Label for the display field. Default the titleized display_field.

bridge_attributes.description: Extra input fields stored on the bridge. Default none.

items.description: An extra input field stored on the association bridge. Always kind input. Same create defaults as attribute.

associationPatch.description: Partial association update (JSON Merge Patch). related_entity identifies the row and is not patchable. Arrays replace wholesale.

display_field.description: Replacement display-field slug. The same type rule applies.

display_field_label.description: Replacement display-field label. Null resets it to the titleized display_field.

bridge_attributes.description: Replacement bridge-attribute list. Prefer add/update/remove_bridge_attribute for surgical edits.

items.description: An extra input field stored on the association bridge. Always kind input. Same create defaults as attribute.

position.description: Insert relative to an existing item. Omit to append at the end. Give exactly one of before or after.

before.description: Place the item immediately before this existing slug or group key.

after.description: Place the item immediately after this existing slug or group key.

allOf.description: Do not send both before and after.

ruleLite.description: One attribute rule. Same fields as a full rule. type must be allowed for the html_type.

type.description: Rule type. Same values as attributes[].rules[].type, where every value is listed with its meaning, value fields and allowed html_types.

value.description: Bound for single-value rules such as length_maximum. Default none.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for range rules. Default none.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for range rules. Must be >= min.

pattern.description: Ruby regular expression for format_custom. Default none.

values.description: Allowed or excluded strings for inclusion/exclusion. Default none. At most 200.

attributeLite.description: Create-shaped attribute. Omitted kind is input and omitted html_type is text. Select/radio/checkbox require options; calculated requires formula; computed requires aggregate.

name.description: Field label used to derive the slug when slug is omitted.

slug.description: Stable attribute identifier derived from name when omitted. Immutable after create. Used by formulas, aggregates, defaults, and change ops.

description.description: Optional help text under the control. Default empty.

kind.description: How the value is produced. Default input.

html_type.description: Form control. Default text. Computed attributes are stored as number.

group.description: Group key this field belongs to. Default ungrouped. Must match an attribute_groups key.

rules.description: Attribute rules (validators). Default none. Allowed types depend on html_type. At most 20.

items.description: One attribute rule. Same fields as a full rule. type must be allowed for the html_type.

access.description: Who sees the field and who the rules apply to. Default all audiences true. Rules apply only where the field is visible.

options.description: Choice list for select, radio, and checkbox. Required on those html_types.

file.description: Upload settings for file and image controls. Ignored on other html_types.

formula.description: Expression over sibling attribute slugs. Required when kind is calculated. Identifiers must be slugs on this entity.

aggregate.description: Computed aggregate through an association bridge. Required when kind is computed.

owner.description: When true, this reference marks which person the record belongs to. Valid only on an entity_entries field whose target is a person entity, at most once per entity. Omit when false.

optionsLite.description: Choice list. Same fields as options. source is static, constant, or entity_entries.

source.description: Where the choices come from: static, constant, or entity_entries.

values.description: Static choices. Required when source is static. At most 200. Duplicate stored values are rejected.

items.description: One static choice. A string is stored as both label and value.

constant.description: Constant name. Required when source is constant. Customer-owned constants win over shared namesakes.

entity.description: Entity whose entries fill the list. Required when source is entity_entries. May name an entity in this same call.

label_field.description: Slug of a human-readable attribute of that entity (text, search, email, tel, url, number or date) shown as the choice label. The stored value is always the record id.

allOf.description: source entity_entries requires entity and label_field.

aggregateFilterLite.description: Keep related bridge rows matching this comparison. Default none (all rows).

value.description: Value compared against the filter attribute.

aggregateLite.description: Computed aggregate. Same fields as aggregate.

related_entity.description: Entity this aggregate walks to. May name an entity in this same call. An association must exist in the declared direction.

function.description: Aggregate function: avg, sum, count, min, or max. count does not need source_attribute.

source_attribute.description: Bridge-attribute slug to aggregate. Required except for count. Must be numeric for avg, sum, min, and max.

precision.description: Decimal places for non-count functions. Default none (unrounded).

filter.description: Keep related bridge rows matching this comparison. Default none.

direction.description: Which side owns the association: source or target. Default source.
